name: Demon Of Jealousy
description: A fickle creature of spindly limbs and insatiable desires.

abilities.name: Unprotected Mind
abilities.description: The Demon’s standard attack deals direct damage.

abilities.name: My Turn
abilities.description: When the Demon marks HP from an attack, spend a number of Fear equal to the HP marked by the Demon to cause the attacker to mark the same number of HP.

abilities.name: Rivalry
abilities.description: When a creature within Close range takes damage from a different adversary, you can mark a Stress to add a d4 to the damage roll.

abilities.name: What’s Yours Is Mine
abilities.description: When a PC takes Severe damage within Very Close range of the Demon, you can spend a Fear to cause the target to make a Finesse Reaction Roll. On a failure, the Demon seizes one item or consumable of their choice from the target’s inventory.
